annotations.text:
Library-first, not upload-first.

The web opens on an upload form because a visitor arrives cold with a file. An installed app opens on your music. Adding is one accent capsule in thumb reach.

Ready sheets carry no status badge - only the states that need attention (processing, failed) say anything.

No status page.

Upload runs on a background URLSession; the job reports through a Live Activity and a notification. Close the app and you still get told.

Stage text is verbatim from the pipeline.

Read vs Practice.

Portrait is for reading the sheet on a music stand: page full-width, one floating transport, keyboard out of the way.

The dimmed third line is the signed-out limit, visible before you hit it rather than as an error after.
Corrections by direct manipulation: tap the wrong note on the sheet. The web's "pick a measure, then pick from a dropdown" indirection is gone.

Landscape only, deliberately.

88 keys across a 390pt portrait phone are 4pt wide - unreadable. Rotating is the mode switch.

Roll lanes and key positions are generated from keyboard-layout.ts's real geometry, including the uneven black-key offsets, so what you see here is what the app would draw.
